About this item

  • Color & Finish: Tortoise shell frame with smoke mono lenses offers a refined look that complements both casual and elevated outfits.
  • High-Quality Lenses: Scratch-resistant lenses provide long-lasting clarity and durability, keeping your vision sharp and your sunglasses looking pristine.
  • Comfortable Fit: With a lens width of 51mm, a 22mm nose bridge, and 144mm temples, these sunglasses provide a flattering and comfortable fit for a variety of face shapes.
  • Elegant oversized cat eye silhouette, a signature Le Specs design that creates a bold and stylish statement with a feminine appeal.
  • Included Accessories: Each pair comes with a spring-close protective pouch and a microfiber cleaning cloth to keep your sunglasses protected and spotless.

  10. Le Specs is a globally recognized eyewear brand founded in 1979, celebrated for its iconic and fashion-forward sunglasses at an accessible price point. Known as the ultimate accessory, the brand has built a cult following worldwide through its trend-driven designs and innovative collections.

  11. Over the years, Le Specs has become a go-to eyewear brand for some of the world’s most influential celebrities, musicians, models, and tastemakers. Frequently spotted on global style icons including Beyoncé, Rihanna, Gigi and Bella Hadid, Lady Gaga, Zayn Malik, Kendall Jenner and Justin Bieber.

  12. Le Specs Global Fit +

    The Le Specs Global Fit+ range offers a comfortable, inclusive fit, designed to suit a variety of facial features for sunglasses that look and feel great.

    What are Polarised Sunglasses & do you really need them?

    Polarized lenses block horizontal light waves, reducing glare, improving clarity, enhancing colors, and reducing eye fatigue.

    How do I find the perfect pair of Le Specs for my style?

    The pair of Le Specs comes down to your personal style and fit, whether you prefer timeless classics or bold statement frames, choose a pair that feels comfortable and effortless to wear.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    5 out of 5 stars
    5 Stars (For quality — just not my face shape!)
    Reviewed in the United States on March 11, 2026
    Color: Caramel Frame/Khaki Lens
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I recently ordered the Le Specs Air Heart sunglasses and was genuinely impressed the moment I took them out of the box. They feel really well made and much higher quality than I expected for the price. Definitely great value for the money.

    I ordered the tan color, and just a heads up — it reads more like a light brown/caramel in person, which I actually loved. It’s a really pretty, neutral shade that would go with everything.

    Unfortunately, I ended up returning them because the frame shape just wasn’t right for my face. I wasn’t totally confident I could pull off the style (sadly!). But that’s purely a personal fit issue — the quality, color, and price point were all fantastic.

    If the Air Heart style works for your face shape, I would absolutely recommend them!

    This is my second time purchasing the air hearts and I really love this style. It is the first time I go back and purchase the same sunglasses. I bought them from the le specs site a few years back and this time from Amazon because I needed them to arrive fast. I noticed some people also had the same issue as I did, where one of the temples/arms broke off. I will be sad if this happens again, so I will try to take better care of them. These sunglasses are oversized, cat eye, elegant and go with almost everyone. I am trying the black polarized ones this time to see if there is any difference to the non polarized I got last time.

About this Item

  • Color & Finish: Tortoise shell frame with smoke mono lenses offers a refined look that complements both casual and elevated outfits.
  • High-Quality Lenses: Scratch-resistant lenses provide long-lasting clarity and durability, keeping your vision sharp and your sunglasses looking pristine.
  • Comfortable Fit: With a lens width of 51mm, a 22mm nose bridge, and 144mm temples, these sunglasses provide a flattering and comfortable fit for a variety of face shapes.
  • Elegant oversized cat eye silhouette, a signature Le Specs design that creates a bold and stylish statement with a feminine appeal.
  • Included Accessories: Each pair comes with a spring-close protective pouch and a microfiber cleaning cloth to keep your sunglasses protected and spotless.

Product Description

Elevate your style with the Le Specs Air Heart Cat Eye Sunglasses for women. The scratch-resistant lenses provide clear, long-lasting vision, keeping your eyewear looking sharp over time. The oversized silhouette is a signature Le Specs design, creating a bold and flattering statement. With a lens width of 51mm, a 22mm nose bridge, and 144mm temples, these sunglasses offer a comfortable fit for a variety of face shapes. Each pair comes with a spring-close protective pouch and a microfiber cleaning cloth, keeping your glasses protected and spotless. This style is available in a variety of frame colors and lens options, allowing you to find a pair that suits your personal look. These cat eye sunglasses are versatile and stylish, a statement accessory for anyone who wants to stand out.
